clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within Gnomeregan, the Engineering Labs lie in ruin, their tiers linked to the Workshop Entrance and Launch Bay. Once a busy center of gnome innovation, they were overrun in the city's radioactive cataclysm. Crazed leper gnomes and rogue mechanical contraptions now fill the chambers.

The Engineering Labs were once a busy center of gnome innovation. Built around a central mechanical structure, they span two main tiers joined by a central cargo lift. At Gnomeregan's height, tinkerers developed schematics and refined clockwork inventions here. Radiation drove the remaining researchers mad, turning them into deranged leper gnomes who mindlessly guard malfunctioning machinery alongside rogue constructs.

The Engineering Labs also link routes through the lower reaches of the ruined city. Passages lead toward the Launch Bay, Tinkers' Court, and the Workshop Entrance back door. On the lower floor, Matrix Punchograph 3005-D terminals process coded punch cards carried by gnome engineers.
